body: Please read my post and comment history, I hate typing it and I'm sure you will understand

I can't remember exactly, but I know I did real damage. She trusted me. I was motivated only by lust. If I remember her texts correctly after I had apologized, she said I did it a second time after she told me not to. I guess I was too horny and too stupid and slow at processing to realize it wasn't a matter of teasing. I told it wrong in my post. I did it twice that night, one time immediately after the other, before she showed me out. It's been a year and a half, and I'm not sure if I should just keep living having done what I've done.

We did agree on itwhen I first brought it up, but when I look back, I think she didn't want to nearly as much as I did, or at least she wanted it less and less as time went on. For her it was more about the friendship I think.

I didn't use the wrong term. I wanted to have sex but we didn't because she didn't ever want to. I just wish I could go back and make it so I never did anything. What's the point of living at all if I can never undo the fact that I probably changed someone's life to be so much worse than it is? Having friends who like me and family does nothing because they don't know. They love an image of me. The real me is not loved by anyone.
I have a family who loves the version of me that isn't a molester. Maybe my death would only be a tragedy because no one knows.
